Description (SPA): Mes al que corresponde la observacion de aprobacion.
Description (ENG): Month to which the approval observation belongs.
Notes: Observations are aligned to month for cross-sexenio comparisons.

Role: Composite primary key component; foreign key
Description (SPA): Identificador de la casa encuestadora que produjo la observacion.
Description (ENG): Identifier of the polling house that produced the observation.
Notes: One pollster can contribute multiple observations in a month.

Description (SPA): Consecutivo que distingue observaciones de la misma casa en el mismo mes.
Description (ENG): Sequence distinguishing observations from the same house in the same month.
Notes: Defaults to 1 when only one observation is recorded.

Description (SPA): Clave de la presidencia a la que pertenece la observacion.
Description (ENG): Presidential term key to which the observation belongs.
Values / Domain: EZPL VFQ FCH EPN AMLO Sheinbaum or NULL
Notes: Used to align observations by months in office.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje que aprueba la gestion presidencial.
Notes: Stored in percentage points rather than a 0-1 fraction.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje que desaprueba la gestion presidencial.
Notes: Stored in percentage points rather than a 0-1 fraction.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje restante no clasificado como aprueba o desaprueba.
Description (ENG): Residual percentage not classified as approval or disapproval.
Notes: Usually represents non-response or another reported category.

Description (SPA): Modalidad de levantamiento de la encuesta.
Values / Domain: e.g. Telefónica Vivienda Online or NULL
Notes: May be unavailable in the source.
Logical foreign key; provenance can be unavailable for legacy series.

Description (SPA): Metodo con el que se incorporo la observacion.
Description (ENG): Method by which the observation was incorporated.
Notes: Indicates the extraction workflow and is not a survey method.
